gate.note: Required by a repository-level rule. Outside the pull request's tree, but a repository admin can change it.

scope.note: No scope registry was configured. Whether these standards govern this repository is unreviewed here.

denominator.basis: required- and forbidden-level rules that were evaluated

frameworkCoverage.note: Coverage describes the framework, not the project. A rule with no mechanism reports not-evaluated; it never passes by default.

results.message: No automated mechanism can establish data.provenance-documented from repository contents.
results.remediation: Add a dataset card — DATASET.md or DATA_CARD.md — covering origin, collection mechanism, population, unit of observation, and an exclusions section listing each rule applied with the count and proportion it removed.
results.evidenceExpected: A provenance document carrying origin, collection, population, and exclusions sections, plus an attestation that the exclusions listed are all of them.

results.message: No automated mechanism can establish data.no-silent-exclusions from repository contents.
results.remediation: Restore the excluded observations and re-evaluate, or justify the exclusion by a rule that was specified before the results were seen and record it with its effect.
results.evidenceExpected: An attestation that each exclusion was rule-driven and pre-specified rather than selected after a disappointing evaluation, with the provenance document's exclusions section as supporting evidence.

results.message: No automated mechanism can establish data.version-pinned from repository contents.
results.remediation: Add a versioning mechanism beside the data — a .dvc file, a lockfile, a manifest, or adjacent checksums — and cite the identifier from the experiment records that used it.
results.evidenceExpected: A version manifest, lockfile, or checksum set covering the datasets in use, and experiment records naming the version each result came from.

results.message: No automated mechanism can establish data.feature-lineage-documented from repository contents.
results.remediation: Build a feature register, documented schema, or feature-store definition naming sources, transformations, and availability timing per feature, and keep it current with the transformation code.
results.evidenceExpected: A lineage record sufficient to answer, for each feature, whether it derives from information unavailable at prediction time and whether it derives from the target.

results.message: No completed model card was found.
evidence: README.md has no section answering this
results.remediation: Add a MODEL_CARD.md covering model details, intended use, training data, evaluation with a baseline and a segment breakdown, calibration, and limitations. The templates directory ships a conforming example.
results.evidenceExpected: A model card carrying at minimum an intended-use section, an evaluation section, and a limitations section.

results.message: No automated mechanism can establish deployment.inference-contract from repository contents.
results.remediation: Write the contract, and share the fitted transformation artifact between training and serving rather than reimplementing it on each side.
results.evidenceExpected: An inference specification covering inputs, transformations, outputs, thresholds, latency, and failure behaviour, plus an attestation that serving applies the training transformations.

results.message: Training code is present and no completed evaluation write-up was found, so there is nowhere a baseline could have been reported.
results.remediation: Add the strongest simple thing that could reasonably work — a constant predictor, the current production rule, a linear model on the obvious features — evaluate it on the same split, and report it alongside.
results.evidenceExpected: A baseline section or a baseline row in the results table of the evaluation document, showing the same metric on the same split.

results.message: No automated mechanism can establish evaluation.no-baseline-free-claims from repository contents.
results.remediation: State the baseline, its score, and the difference. Where the baseline was chosen for convenience, replace it with the strongest simple alternative and re-state the claim.
results.evidenceExpected: An attestation that the baseline used for each improvement claim was the strongest reasonable simple alternative, not one selected for being beatable.

results.message: No automated mechanism can establish evaluation.no-training-metrics-as-production from repository contents.
results.remediation: Report the held-out estimate as the performance figure, and label training performance as training performance wherever it appears.
results.evidenceExpected: An attestation that each reported performance figure is labelled with the partition it was computed on.

results.message: No automated mechanism can establish evaluation.no-cherry-picked-periods from repository contents.
results.remediation: Fix the evaluation window in advance and report performance across all of it, including the periods that perform worst.
results.evidenceExpected: An attestation naming when the evaluation period was fixed relative to the results, and stating what other windows, if any, were examined.

results.message: No automated mechanism can establish evaluation.class-imbalance-addressed from repository contents.
results.remediation: State the class distribution beside the metric, choose a metric that survives it, and disclose any resampling along with what it does to the implied base rate.
results.evidenceExpected: The measured class distribution recorded with the evaluation, and a disclosure of any resampling or weighting applied.

results.message: No automated mechanism can establish evaluation.resampling-not-by-default from repository contents.
results.remediation: Evaluate without resampling first. Where resampling is retained, record why it was necessary for this learner and this metric, and disclose its effect under R4.
results.evidenceExpected: Either a recorded determination that no resampling was applied, or a recorded justification for the resampling used, naming the learner and the metric it was judged against.

results.message: No automated mechanism can establish evaluation.metric-selection-justified from repository contents.
results.remediation: Record the metric and the reasoning that produced it, referencing the cost asymmetry from the problem formulation, before running the evaluation that will be reported.
results.evidenceExpected: A recorded metric choice with its justification, dated before the reported results, plus the set of metrics reported together where more than one is relevant.

results.message: No automated mechanism can establish evaluation.no-result-driven-metrics from repository contents.
results.remediation: Report every metric that was identified as relevant when the problem was formulated, including the ones that came out worse.
results.evidenceExpected: An attestation that the reported metrics are the ones fixed in advance, and that no computed metric was dropped for being unflattering.

results.message: No automated mechanism can establish evaluation.no-accuracy-by-default from repository contents.
results.remediation: Choose a metric that reflects the base rate and the cost asymmetry, and report accuracy only alongside it, if at all.
results.evidenceExpected: A recorded justification that the reported metric suits the base rate and the cost of each error type.

results.message: No automated mechanism can establish evaluation.calibration-evidence from repository contents.
results.remediation: Measure calibration on held-out data and report it, or stop describing the output as a probability and call it a score.
results.evidenceExpected: A calibration measurement on held-out data, reported with the model, or a recorded determination that the output is not consumed as a probability.

results.message: No automated mechanism can establish evaluation.no-uncalibrated-confidence-claims from repository contents.
results.remediation: Measure calibration, or rename the output and correct the downstream uses that assumed otherwise.
results.evidenceExpected: An attestation that every place the output is described as a probability is backed by a calibration measurement.

results.message: No automated mechanism can establish evaluation.ablation-performed from repository contents.
results.remediation: Run one ablation per separable component against the same split and metric, and report every arm including the ones that changed nothing.
results.evidenceExpected: Ablation results covering each separable component, reported with the same metric and split as the headline comparison.

results.message: No automated mechanism can establish evaluation.no-incompatible-comparisons from repository contents.
results.remediation: Re-evaluate the compared models under identical conditions, or state the differing condition as the variable under study.
results.evidenceExpected: A recorded comparison protocol naming the shared dataset version, split, metric, and preprocessing, plus an attestation that every compared result used it.

results.message: No automated mechanism can establish evaluation.improvement-classification from repository contents.
results.remediation: For each claimed improvement, say whether it is unlikely to be noise, whether it is large enough to change the decision it feeds, and whether it survives production conditions — naming any of the three that was not assessed.
results.evidenceExpected: Comparison write-ups that classify each claimed improvement across the three kinds, with the evidence for each classification.

results.message: No automated mechanism can establish evaluation.no-complexity-by-default from repository contents.
results.remediation: Quantify the uncertainty around the difference, and state what the added complexity costs and what it buys, before selecting.
results.evidenceExpected: An uncertainty estimate around the difference and a recorded justification for the added complexity.

results.message: No automated mechanism can establish evaluation.uncertainty-reported from repository contents.
results.remediation: Report variance across folds or seeds, or an interval around the difference, and match the method to the source of variation being estimated.
results.evidenceExpected: An uncertainty estimate reported with each comparison, and the method used to produce it.

results.message: No automated mechanism can establish evaluation.segment-performance-reported from repository contents.
results.remediation: Add a segment breakdown to the evaluation and to the model card, choosing segments by who is affected rather than by what is convenient to compute.
results.evidenceExpected: A segment-level results table in the evaluation document or model card, covering the segments identified as consequential.

results.message: No automated mechanism can establish evaluation.no-hidden-segments from repository contents.
results.remediation: Report every consequential segment. Where a breakdown genuinely cannot be published, say that it exists and why it is withheld.
results.evidenceExpected: An attestation that the reported segments are all the consequential ones, naming any withheld and the reason.

results.message: No automated mechanism can establish framing.problem-documented from repository contents.
results.remediation: Write the formulation: target definition precise enough to label any observation, unit of prediction, deployment population, the decision consuming the output, and the relative cost of a false positive against a false negative. Qualitative cost is acceptable where quantitative is not available; silence is not, because it reads downstream as a claim of symmetry.
results.evidenceExpected: A problem-definition document, or a model card whose intended-use and target sections carry that content, together with an attestation stating when it was written relative to the first model.

results.message: No automated mechanism can establish integrity.no-fabricated-datasets from repository contents.
results.remediation: Label synthetic or simulated data as such wherever the dataset is described, and correct any reported size or coverage figure that counted generated records as collected ones.
results.evidenceExpected: An attestation from someone who traced the dataset to its collection mechanism, naming what they checked and confirming that every record described as observed was obtained rather than generated.

results.message: No automated mechanism can establish integrity.no-fabricated-training-results from repository contents.
results.remediation: Re-run the configuration and report what it produced, or withdraw the figure. Where a number is an expectation rather than a measurement, say so in the place it is reported.
results.evidenceExpected: An attestation that reported training figures were traced to the runs that produced them, naming the run records or experiment-tracking entries examined.

results.message: No automated mechanism can establish integrity.no-fabricated-evaluation-metrics from repository contents.
results.remediation: Re-run the evaluation on the stated data and split, and report what it produced. Where a figure came from a different split than the one it is presented under, correct the attribution.
results.evidenceExpected: An attestation that reported metrics were traced to the evaluation runs and splits they claim, naming the records examined.

results.message: No violation of leakage.no-preprocessing-leakage was observed, and the observation is not probative here: the fit-before-split check reads scikit-learn preprocessing and splitting calls, and this project uses no recognised preprocessor.
results.remediation: Move preprocessing inside a pipeline that is fitted per split or per fold, so the transformation sees exactly what the inference path will see.
results.evidenceExpected: Pipeline-scoped preprocessing, or an attestation that every fitted transformation was checked to be fitted on training data only.

results.message: No automated mechanism can establish leakage.no-future-information from repository contents.
results.remediation: Recompute every feature as of the prediction moment, bound aggregate windows to end before it, and re-evaluate. A model trained on future information cannot be repaired by adjusting its threshold.
results.evidenceExpected: An attestation from a reviewer who traced each feature's population time against the prediction moment, naming the lineage record and pipeline code examined.

results.message: No automated mechanism can establish leakage.no-target-in-features from repository contents.
results.remediation: Remove the feature, or reconstruct it from data available before the outcome. Then re-evaluate: the previous result described a different problem.
results.evidenceExpected: An attestation from someone who understands the data, confirming per feature that it is not derived from the target or from the process that generates it, and naming the lineage record consulted.

results.message: No automated mechanism can establish leakage.feature-availability-verified from repository contents.
results.remediation: For each feature, confirm the inference path can reach its source within the latency budget, and record the finding in the lineage record.
results.evidenceExpected: A per-feature availability determination, and an attestation that the inference path was checked against it.

results.message: No automated mechanism can establish leakage.no-unavailable-features-at-inference from repository contents.
results.remediation: Remove the unavailable feature and retrain, or make the feature available on the inference path with an acceptable latency, and re-evaluate either way.
results.evidenceExpected: An attestation that every required feature was confirmed reachable at inference, listing the features and how each was confirmed.

results.message: No automated mechanism can establish monitoring.drift-response-defined from repository contents.
results.remediation: Write the thresholds, the response for each, and the owner, before deployment rather than after the first alert.
results.evidenceExpected: A drift-monitoring specification listing metrics, thresholds, responses, and owners, plus an attestation that it is the one in force.

results.message: No automated mechanism can establish monitoring.no-ignored-shift from repository contents.
results.remediation: Record a disposition for each shift finding — retrain, adjust, accept with a reason, or escalate — with a date and an owner.
results.evidenceExpected: A record of shift findings and their dispositions, and an attestation that no finding was left undispositioned.

results.message: No automated mechanism can establish monitoring.retraining-policy from repository contents.
results.remediation: Write the policy, and make the evaluation gate a blocking step in the retraining pipeline rather than a report produced after promotion.
results.evidenceExpected: A retraining policy document naming trigger, window, gate, and rollback, and an attestation that the pipeline enforces the gate.

results.message: No automated mechanism can establish monitoring.production-monitoring-defined from repository contents.
results.remediation: Define the monitored signals and their segmentation, with thresholds, alerts, and owners, before deployment.
results.evidenceExpected: A monitoring specification covering the signals and their segmentation, and an attestation that it is deployed and firing.

results.message: Training code is present and no experiment configuration artifact was found.
results.remediation: Adopt a configuration file or an experiment-tracking tool and record the full parameter set per run, including the data version and the seeds.
results.evidenceExpected: A configuration artifact per experiment — params.yaml, a conf directory, or tracked runs — carrying code version, data version, hyperparameters, environment, and seeds.

results.message: No violation of reproducibility.dependencies-pinned was observed.
results.remediation: Either pin each declared dependency to an exact version, or commit the lock artifact your ecosystem produces beside the ranged manifest. A project consumed as a dependency should do the second.

results.message: No automated mechanism can establish reproducibility.no-unsubstantiated-claims from repository contents.
results.remediation: Either complete the configuration record until the result can be obtained again, or state plainly that the work is not currently reproducible and why.
results.evidenceExpected: An attestation that someone reran an experiment from its recorded configuration and obtained the reported result, or an explicit statement that the work is not reproducible.

results.message: No violation of reproducibility.seeds-recorded was observed.
results.remediation: Set and record a seed for each randomness source, and verify determinism by running twice rather than assuming it.

results.message: No automated mechanism can establish reproducibility.notebook-hygiene from repository contents.
results.remediation: Restart the kernel, run all cells, and commit the result — or strip outputs and move the result-producing path into a script.
results.evidenceExpected: Notebooks whose execution counts ascend without gaps, or a scripted pipeline that produces the reported results outside a notebook.

results.message: No automated mechanism can establish split.holdout-designated from repository contents.
results.remediation: Declare the three partitions, separate the test set first, and check that the split key is the unit of prediction rather than the row index.
results.evidenceExpected: Split code or configuration showing three distinct partitions and the key they are split on, with an attestation that no observation's group spans a boundary.

results.message: No violation of split.no-test-set-tuning was observed, and the observation is not probative here: the test-set-tuning check reads a conventionally test-named object passed to a fit-family call, and this project shows neither.
results.remediation: Move the selection signal to validation data or an inner cross-validation loop. Where the test set has already driven choices, it is no longer a held-out set: obtain fresh data before reporting a generalisation estimate, and say what happened.
results.evidenceExpected: A search procedure scored against validation data, plus an attestation recording how many times the test set was examined and whether any choice followed from it.

results.message: No automated mechanism can establish split.cv-scheme-justified from repository contents.
results.remediation: Determine whether observations are grouped or time-ordered, select the matching splitter, and record why. Fit every transformation inside each fold rather than once over the whole dataset.
results.evidenceExpected: A recorded determination of the data's dependence structure and the splitter chosen to match it.

results.message: No automated mechanism can establish split.no-inappropriate-cv-scheme from repository contents.
results.remediation: Replace the splitter with one that matches the structure: grouped folds for entity-level dependence, forward-chaining folds for time order.
results.evidenceExpected: An attestation that the fold scheme was checked against the data's dependence structure, naming the code reviewed.
